_comment: Edit this file to change what the morning sweep watches — no code change needed. allowed_domains is a hard gate for the VERIFIED tier: a finding whose document lives outside these domains cannot enter the library. news_domains is the gate for the REPORTED tier: a press report from one of these is shown on the card as 'reported in press', never touches the library and never flags a matter. Anything from any other domain is rejected.

sources.name: SECP
sources.description: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan — circulars, SROs, notifications, draft regulations for public consultation, and amendments to company and securities law

sources.name: PPP Authority (Federal)
sources.description: Pakistan Public Private Partnership Authority (P3A) — PPP policy, rules, regulations, guidelines and amendments to the PPP Authority Act

sources.name: Punjab PPP
sources.description: Punjab PPP Authority and the Punjab government — provincial PPP legislation, rules and notifications

sources.name: Sindh PPP
sources.description: Sindh PPP Unit and the Sindh government — provincial PPP legislation, rules and notifications

sources.name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa PPP
sources.description: KP PPP Unit and the KP government — provincial PPP legislation, rules and notifications

sources.name: Balochistan PPP
sources.description: Balochistan government — provincial PPP legislation, rules and notifications

sources.name: NEPRA
sources.description: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority — rules, regulations, draft regulations for consultation, tariff regimes and amendments affecting power projects

sources.name: Parliament
sources.description: National Assembly and Senate of Pakistan — bills introduced or passed, ordinances laid, Acts assented to, particularly corporate, commercial, procurement, PPP, energy, telecom and arbitration law

sources.name: Legal press
sources.description: Pakistani business and legal press — reports of new ordinances, Acts, bills, SROs, draft regulations and amendments affecting corporate, commercial, procurement, PPP, energy and telecom law. Press reports are shown as 'reported' until the official text is found.
